RETROSPECTIVE ARCHITECTURE DECISION · 11 OCTOBER 2026

ADR-0007: OPA rules with trusted current facts

Status

Accepted; local OPA calls implemented, signed distribution proposed

Context

Policies must be inspectable and shared across export, import and business-read admission.

Decision

Use Rego v1 and local OPA decision services. Construct policy input from trusted state. Evaluate source and recipient admission; enforce route, writer and data versions transactionally outside OPA as well.

Alternatives

Ad hoc policy flags in every service; remote central policy call for every decision; trusting a previous allow event forever.

Consequences

A bundle rollout is not a simultaneous authority fence. Signed rules, fact freshness, revocation leases/watermarks and rule hashes remain pilot controls.

Evidence

poc/policies; poc/app.py; poc/operational.py; poc/migration.py

Gate

Missing/invalid decisions fail closed; stale allowed events cannot restore prohibited data.
